# Exercise 1

Without running the code, determine the result (or error) of each expression.

## R

```{r}
x = c(a = 2, b = 4, c = 6, d = 8)

x[c(1, 3)]          # 
x[-c(1, 3)]         # 
x[c(TRUE, FALSE)]   # 
x[c("d", "b", "z")] # 
x[x > 3 & x < 8]    # 
```

## Python / NumPy

```{python}
#| eval: false
x = np.array([2, 4, 6, 8])

x[[0, 2]]                    # 
x[-2:]                       # 
x[np.array([True, False])]   # 
x[x > 3 & x < 8]             # 
x[(x > 3) & (x < 8)]         # 
```
